blocks.text: LUCENA CITY—A total of 141 hawksbill sea turtle hatchlings (Eretmochelys imbricata), locally known as “pawikan,” were released into their natural habitat in the Verde Island Passage (VIP) off Nasugbu, Batangas. In a report on Sunday, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)-Calabarzon said the hatchlings were released along the coast of a resort in Barangay Balaytigue on Nov. 21. According to the DENR, the release was conducted at sunset to minimize the risk of predation and other threats and improve the hatchlings’ chances of survival.
